description: Versatile data handling class for test executive applications, supporting import/export in various formats, data manipulation, metadata, and configuration-based relationships. Supports large datasets via chunked imports and partitioned Parquet exports. Licensed under MPL 2.0.

features.storage: Microsoft.Data.Analysis.DataFrame (Arrow-backed) for data storage. Dictionary<string, object> for metadata (constants).
features.import: CSV (chunked for large), Parquet (partitioned), SQLite, Archive (zip/tar.gz/tar.xz of CSVs), DataBall (.ball ZIP with partitioned Parquet and JSON metadata).
features.export: CSV, Parquet (partitioned), SQLite, Archive (zip/tar.gz/tar.xz with CSV), DataBall (.ball ZIP with partitioned Parquet and JSON metadata).
features.manipulation: Add/Remove columns, Add/Remove rows, Set cell values, Row builder: InitializeRow (optional initial values), ModifyField, CommitRow (commit with propagation and relationships), Bounce: Compact by removing constants to metadata, deduplicate rows, chunk deduplication (4x4 to 1000x1000, max 5 tables), Squish: Full chunk deduplication and partitioning for disk storage, Roll: Export to specified format with switch on ExportType enum, DataFrame ops: Select, Filter, GroupBy, Join, Pivot, Sort, Aggregate.
features.config: JSON for metadata, column types (int, long, float, double, bool, datetime, string), relationships (trigger field and list of fields to reset if trigger changes).
features.merge: Append with schema alignment, type coercion for mismatches, filling nulls for missing columns. Checks metadata consistency, promotes to columns if values differ.
features.relationships: On CommitRow, if trigger field changed (value differs from original or newly set), reset dependent fields to null unless explicitly modified.
features.backend: IDataBackend interface with InMemoryBackend (DataFrame) and ParquetBackend (lazy streaming of row groups).
features.versioning: Metadata['Version'] = '1.0' on save; on import, if < '1.0', call MigrateData (add columns, convert formats).
features.error_handling: DataBallException base, ImportException, ExportException subclasses. Wrap import/export, log with NLog.Error, throw custom exceptions.

implementation_details.backend_abstraction: IDataBackend with LoadData, SaveData, Filter (extend for GroupBy, Join, etc.). InMemoryBackend uses DataFrame; ParquetBackend streams Parquet row groups for out-of-core.
implementation_details.versioning: Metadata['Version'] = '1.0' on save; import checks version, runs MigrateData for older formats (e.g., add missing columns).
implementation_details.error_handling: Wrap import/export in try/catch, log with NLog, throw DataBallException/ImportException/ExportException.
implementation_details.dataframe_ops: Delegate to DataFrame methods (e.g., public DataFrame Filter(Func<DataFrameRow, bool> predicate) => Data.Filter(predicate);). Bounce before Save/Roll.
implementation_details.bounce: Remove constants to metadata, deduplicate rows, chunk deduplication (4x4 to 1000x1000, max 5 tables) for in-memory operability.
implementation_details.squish: Full chunk deduplication (no table limit) and partitioning for disk storage, reconstruct on import with Bounce.
implementation_details.roll: ExportType enum (Csv, Parquet, Sqlite, Archive, DataBall); switch to call ExportTo* methods.
implementation_details.chunk_deduplication: Scan for duplicate matrices (min 4x4, max 1000x1000), replace with IDs in metadata tables. Bounce limits to 5 tables for performance; Squish uses full deduplication.

documentation_needs.updates: Include backend abstraction, versioning, error handling, exposed DataFrame ops, updated Roll, Bounce with chunk deduplication (max 5 tables), Squish for full partitioning, tar.gz/tar.xz export support, robust merge with type coercion.

recreation_instructions: Create a new .NET 9.0 project with Microsoft.Data.Analysis, Parquet.Net, SharpCompress, System.Text.Json, Microsoft.Data.Sqlite, NLog. Implement DataBall with features: multi-format import/export, row builder, Bounce (5-table limit), Squish (full partitioning), DataFrame ops, backend abstraction, versioning, custom exceptions. Add xUnit tests. Support large data with chunked imports, partitioned exports. Use ZIP for .ball files, support tar.gz/tar.xz for archives. License under MPL 2.0. Use NLog for logging.
